slate_config.name: Slate Config
slate_config.hub.title: Settings
slate_config.hub.reset_tab.body: Reset every option in "%s" to its default? Other tabs are not touched.
slate_config.list.placeholder: Type a value, Enter adds it
slate_config.list.hint: Double-click an entry to edit it. Changes are written when you save.
slate_config.editor.missing_file: This file does not exist yet. It appears once the mod has written it.
slate_config.editor.parse_error: This file could not be parsed: %s
slate_config.editor.comments_lost: This file contains comments, which cannot be kept when it is saved from here.
slate_config.editor.not_loaded: This %s config is only loaded while a world is open.
slate_config.editor.empty: No editable values in this file
slate_config.video.external_page: A page %s provides through Sodium's settings API; it opens its own screen.
slate_config.audio.music_enabled.tip: Mute or restore the music volume without losing the level you had.
slate_config.controls.search_keys: Search keys by name, key or category…
slate_config.controls.reset_keys.body: Every key bind goes back to its default, including mods' keys.
slate_config.multiplayer.hide_address.ti: Blank out addresses in the server list (streaming).
slate_config.multiplayer.skip_warning.ti: Do not show the third-party server warning again.
slate_config.interface.setup.tip: Run the first-launch setup again: the three switches with live previews.
slate_config.core.customLayout.tip: Slate UI's rebuilt screens (title, worlds, servers, pause, options) replace vanilla's. Off: vanilla's own screens and button placement, with a Slate button on the title and pause screens.
slate_config.core.skin.tip: Dark: the modern pixel look. Vanilla: stone buttons, still animated.
slate_config.core.accent.tip: Used for primary buttons, toggles, focus rings and highlights.
slate_config.core.radius.tip: Pixel steps cut from panel corners on the dark skin.
slate_config.core.headingFont.tip: The pixel font for titles; off uses the vanilla font everywhere.
slate_config.core.pixelFont.tip: The font for titles and headings. Pixeloid Sans (the default) and Monocraft sit on Minecraft's pixel grid and stay crisp at every GUI scale; Pixelify Sans is softer.
slate_config.core.blurInGame.tip: Blur the world behind in-game menus instead of a plain dim.
slate_config.core.motion.tip: Off snaps everything instantly; 2x is slow and cinematic.
slate_config.core.transitions.tip: A short fade when one menu replaces another.
slate_config.core.uiSounds.tip: Soft clicks and ticks on Slate widgets.
slate_config.core.toasts.tip: Slate's toasts: friend online, message received, restart required.
slate_config.core.reskinScope.tip: Which screens get Slate's restyle of vanilla widgets.
slate_config.core.reskinAllowlist.tip: Package prefixes or mod ids whose screens are restyled under the allow-list scope.
slate_config.core.reskinContainers.tip: Inventory, chest, furnace and other container screens get Slate's panel, sunken slot wells, an accent hover ring and light labels, with either menu style. Screens that draw their background in pieces keep their own look; the deny-list applies.
slate_config.core.devMode.tip: Enables the layout editor button and its F7 key.
slate_config.core.devGrid.tip: Show the snap grid in the layout editor.
slate_config.core.devSnap.tip: Grid size the editor snaps to.
slate_config.packs.open.tip: The vanilla pack screen; comes back here when you close it.
slate_config.packs.import.tip: Pick .zip files anywhere on your computer; they are copied into the resource packs folder and show up in the pack screen.
slate_config.shaders.enabled.tip: Turn the selected shader pack on or off. Applies immediately.
slate_config.shaders.import.tip: Pick .zip shader packs anywhere on your computer; they are copied into the shaderpacks folder and the first one is selected.
slate_config.shaders.iris_screen.tip: Iris' own screen: per-pack options and profiles.
slate_config.shaders.empty: No shader packs yet. Drop a pack (.zip or folder) into the shaderpacks folder.
slate_config.gameplay.difficulty.tip: How dangerous this world is. Changes apply at once.
slate_config.gameplay.difficulty.hardcor: Hardcore worlds always play on Hard.
slate_config.gameplay.lock.tip: Fix this world's difficulty for good. It cannot be unlocked again.
slate_config.mods.no_config: No settings found for this mod
slate_config.favourites.empty: Nothing pinned yet. Click the star next to any option to keep it here.
slate_config.curated.unavailable.tip: %s could not be resolved: the mod or file is missing.
slate_config.presets.save_current.body: Snapshot the chosen options under a name; apply them again any time.
slate_config.presets.name: Preset name
slate_config.opt.renderDistance.tip: Chunks of terrain loaded around you. The biggest single frame-rate lever.
slate_config.opt.simulationDistance.tip: How far away mobs, crops and redstone keep ticking.
slate_config.opt.graphicsMode.tip: Fast: opaque leaves, simple weather. Fancy: the full look. Fabulous: transparency through translucent blocks.
slate_config.opt.fov.tip: Field of view. Wider sees more but distorts the edges.
slate_config.opt.guiScale.tip: Size of the interface. Auto picks the largest scale that fits.
slate_config.opt.fullscreen.tip: Borderless full screen on the current monitor.
slate_config.opt.enableVsync.tip: Lock frames to the monitor's refresh rate. Removes tearing, adds a little input lag.
slate_config.opt.maxFps.tip: Frame rate cap. Unlimited lets the GPU run flat out.
slate_config.opt.mipmapLevels.tip: Smooths distant textures. Changing it reloads textures.
slate_config.opt.entityDistanceScaling.t: Multiplier on how far away entities are still rendered.
slate_config.opt.entityShadows.tip: Round shadows under mobs and players.
slate_config.opt.biomeBlendRadius.tip: How smoothly grass and water colours blend between biomes.
When block changes are rebuilt before other chunk work.
slate_config.opt.gamma.tip: Brightness. Moody keeps caves dark; Bright lifts them.
slate_config.opt.renderClouds.tip: Cloud rendering: off, flat or volumetric-looking.
slate_config.opt.ao.tip: Smooth lighting: soft shading in block corners.
slate_config.opt.glintSpeed.tip: How fast the enchantment shimmer moves.
slate_config.opt.glintStrength.tip: How visible the enchantment shimmer is.
slate_config.opt.screenEffectScale.tip: Strength of nausea and nether portal distortion.
slate_config.opt.fovEffectScale.tip: How much sprinting, speed and bows change the field of view.
slate_config.opt.darknessEffectScale.tip: How strongly the Darkness effect pulses.
slate_config.opt.damageTiltStrength.tip: How much the camera tilts when you take damage.
slate_config.opt.attackIndicator.tip: Where the attack cooldown indicator shows.
slate_config.opt.showAutosaveIndicator.t: A small icon while the world saves.
slate_config.opt.rawMouseInput.tip: Bypass the operating system's mouse acceleration.
slate_config.opt.discrete_mouse_scroll.t: Treat every scroll as one notch, for touchpads and free-spinning wheels.
slate_config.opt.toggleSprint.tip: Press once to sprint instead of holding.
slate_config.opt.toggleCrouch.tip: Press once to sneak instead of holding.
slate_config.opt.operatorItemsTab.tip: Show the operator utilities tab in the creative inventory.
slate_config.opt.showSubtitles.tip: Captions for sounds, with their direction.
slate_config.opt.soundDevice.tip: Which output device plays the game's audio.
slate_config.opt.chatLinks.tip: Make web links in chat clickable.
slate_config.opt.chatLinksPrompt.tip: Ask before opening a clicked link.
slate_config.opt.textBackgroundOpacity.t: Background opacity behind chat and other text.
slate_config.opt.backgroundForChatOnly.t: Only chat gets a background; other text stays bare.
slate_config.opt.chatHeightFocused.tip: Height of the chat box while typing.
slate_config.opt.chatHeightUnfocused.tip: Height of the chat box while playing.
slate_config.opt.chatDelay.tip: Delay before a message appears (helps accessibility tools).
slate_config.opt.hideMatchedNames.tip: Hide messages from players you blocked or reported.
slate_config.opt.onlyShowSecureChat.tip: Only show messages that can be verified as unmodified.
slate_config.opt.reducedDebugInfo.tip: Hide coordinates and other details from the F3 screen.
slate_config.opt.notificationDisplayTime: How long toasts stay on screen.
slate_config.opt.narrator.tip: Read the interface and chat aloud.
slate_config.opt.highContrast.tip: Stronger outlines and colours in the interface.
slate_config.opt.forceUnicodeFont.tip: Use the Unicode font instead of the default pixel font.
slate_config.opt.japaneseGlyphVariants.t: Prefer Japanese forms of shared CJK characters.
slate_config.opt.mainHand.tip: Which hand holds the main item.
slate_config.opt.hideSplashTexts.tip: No yellow splash text on the title screen.
slate_config.opt.panoramaScrollSpeed.tip: How fast the title screen panorama spins.
slate_config.opt.realmsNotifications.tip: Realms invites and news on the title screen.
slate_config.opt.allowServerListing.tip: Let servers show your name in their public player list.
slate_config.opt.telemetryOptInExtra.tip: Send optional telemetry (performance and game mode data) to Mojang.
